normalization_audit.control_interpretation: Global-N and expected-W estimators are diagnostic only; the current production estimator is already per-pixel weight normalized.
normalization_audit.equation: I_p = 1[W_p >= 0.05] clamp(1.5 A_p / max(W_p,1e-30), 0, 1); A_p=sum_i w_ip C_i l_i; W_p=sum_i w_ip
normalization_audit.expected_sample_count_behavior: On stable support, multiplying sample count multiplies A_p and W_p together, so brightness is invariant while variance decreases.
